business_problem: build a connected data platform that could support more personalized care, fresher contact-center analytics, and faster operational insight across healthcare operations.
solution_summary: Bupa uses Snowflake on Snowflake to build a connected data platform that could support more personalized care, fresher contact-center analytics, and faster operational insight across healthcare operations. Customer, contact-center, actuarial, and clinical datasets are brought together in Snowflake so Bupa can connect care and customer-service operations. The platform accelerates ingestion and transformation of large contact-center files and gives Bupa a fresher analytical foundation for customer and care insights. Contact-center teams, analysts, and care operations users draw on the shared data to solve customer issues faster, support personalized care, and reduce internal administration. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces copying, simplifies administration, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data for analytics, reporting, and AI. Bupa reduced contact-center data ingestion times by 90%, improved availability for those datasets...

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

data_flow: contact-center, clinical, actuarial, and customer data flow into Snowflake; curated data, reports, and model outputs are then served to service teams, analysts, and care operations users.
business_outcome: Bupa reduced contact-center data ingestion times by 90%, improved availability for those datasets to 99.9%, and created faster, more customer-centric insight across clinical, actuarial, and service operations.
metrics: 60 minutes to ingest these large files — a 90% reduction
architecture_clues: Transforms analytics across actuarial, clinical, customer experience, and contact-center operations.
Replaces an 11-hour overnight contact-center ingest with a much faster cycle.
Supports 360-degree customer views and AI-ready healthcare analytics.
evidence_quotes: Now, it takes just 60 minutes to ingest these large files
